split.scope: Hash of complete game id; every seat and value head excluded from critic fitting; actor still uses these games

weight_recovery.scope: Five consecutive healthy, actually trained iterations at each weight; EV at least the fixed phase-1 baseline. Changes apply next iteration; no historical backfill

critic_rollout.scope: Actual retained PPO/PPG snapshot exposure required; counts per phase may overlap. Sequential heldout diagnostic, not a causal snapshot benefit estimate

recovery_migration.scope: Empty weight-recovery streak; saved weight, baseline, activation, fingerprint, both Adams and GAE state preserved

sampling.scope: Actual completed tables and learner seats; forced decisions are critic-only. Table fractions do not define PPO sample fractions.

legacy_profiles.scope: Actual completed ordinary legacy seats; pottery-flex remains evaluation-only

curriculum.scope: Ordinary game tables only; teacher/evaluation games and optimizer steps do not advance this clock

gae.scope: Raw pre-normalization nonforced learner decisions; critic targets remain Monte Carlo
